system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

See also: Starship Maneuvers

This maneuver allows a Pilot to loop a Vehicle through the same location it just left, launching a surprise attack on an unsuspecting opponent.

[Dogfight]

Time: Reaction

Targets: One target engaged in a Dogfight with you.

Make a Pilot check. If you are engaged in a Dogfight and an opponent fails their opposed Pilot check to make an attack against you, you may activate this maneuver with a DC 20 Pilot check as a Reaction. If successful, you may make an Attack of Opportunity against that opponent.
